newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Arthuis plans news conference at 1600 GMT.
newsitem.headline: France's Arthuis plans news conference at 1600 GMT.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis will hold a news conference at 1600 GMT on savings plans for house purchases, his ministry said on Monday.

The last-minute decision to call a news conference followed speculation in the French press that the government might be preparing to lower the interest rate on these savings plans (Plans d'Epargne Logement (PEL)), popular schemes used by households to save money ahead of buying property.

The interest rate on these savings schemes, set by the government, has stood at 5.25 percent since 1994. Commercial banks say this rate no longer reflects the general level of interest rates in France, which has fallen sharply.
The total amount of savings in the PEL schemes at the end of October was 883 billion francs, up 26 percent on the same period the year before. GD/MEM
